scope: Two frozen research model packages and their experiment evidence. Artifact roles identify the final package targets; paths point to original lab records unless named portable.

outbound_rights.delivery_status_scope: This registry records local package bytes and authorized destinations. The release transfer workflow tracks remote delivery.

field_conventions.sha256: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of exact file bytes.
field_conventions.local_paths: All lab-source paths are relative to the lab checkout root. Some datasets, weights, traces, and regenerator dependencies remain local. The public evidence bundle carries aggregates and hashes.
field_conventions.weights: Tensor byte sizes exclude tokenizer files, configuration, and archive overhead.
field_conventions.memory: MLX allocator bytes, process RSS, and host unified memory capacity are separate observations.

weightforge-step12-installed-mlx-enginee.official_conditions: 512/2048 random prompt tokens, 64 forced output tokens per request, three timed trials after one warmup. Batch size four measures aggregate generation.

statistics.boundary: Approximation from rounded report intervals. Positions count one label and one EOS per sampled example.

sentry-rank4-step48-matched-three-exampl.endpoint: Trusted request versus individually permitted mock proposal. Status and application-bound evidence references.
sentry-rank4-step48-matched-three-exampl.runtime_boundary: Apple MLX GPU. Fresh processes warm each cohort, then measure pre-forward matching-scope trusted-input selection, prompt rendering and tokenization, and one finite three-logit forward/readback per row. Excludes model load, generated token streaming, post-model evidence citation attachment and rendering, dispatch and network. The recorded MLX peak is cumulative within the capture process.
sentry-rank4-step48-matched-three-exampl.staged_archive_replay_scope: Portable wrapper resolver and renderer were replayed using archived three-way logits. The replay verifies exact messages and joint outputs without fresh model generation.

sentry-rank4-factored-followup.mode: Fresh 112-row visible developer panel with a shared clarification detector. Application status, evidence and wrong-match counts are reported separately from native raw status.

historical-benchmark-expansion.scope: Research-only public small panels, simulator studies, randomized controls, historical precision and hardware engineering. These sources have distinct denominators and artifact IDs.
